label: Two clocks on one inhabited identity exercise fibre with no minimal exercise
paraphrase: On the existing alternating exercise graph and two-bearer q3a4 feedback profile, actual identity fibres are inhabited and every actual esse-supplier edge admits backward exercise lifting. Each identity exercise has a two-edge incoming path from another exercise of its own bearer. On this graph, the discrete clock −n is strictly forward and locally finite at the identity fibre and fails to bound that fibre from below. The reflected Zeno clock is strictly forward and bounded below there and fails indexed local finiteness.
